chunks: Jamīl and Muḥammad ibn Ḥumrān asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about whether there is qiṣāṣ between a woman and a man.
He عليه السلام said: “Yes, in wounds, up to one-third they are equal. Then when it reaches one-third, the man rises and the woman decreases.”

key_terms.ارْتَفَعَ الرَّجُلُ: the man’s assessed legal compensation becomes higher
key_terms.سَفَلَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman’s assessed legal compensation becomes lower
key_terms.قِصَاصٌ: retaliation in kind under Islamic law

ai.seo_question: Does qiṣāṣ apply equally between a woman and a man in cases of injury?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on qiṣāṣ and injury compensation between a woman and a man. It states that in wounds they are treated equally up to one-third, but once the threshold of one-third is reached, the ruling distinguishes between the man and the woman.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5240 - Jamil and Muhammad ibn Humran asked Abu Abdullah (as) about whether qiṣaṣ (retaliation in kind) applies between a woman and a man.

Imam (as) replied: "Yes, in cases of wounds (jirahat) up to one-third of the compensation, they are equal. However, once it reaches one-third, the man's compensation increases, and the woman's compensation decreases."
